JJ is currently the Lab Manager at the Schumer Lab at Stanford University. He is interested in using genomic techniques and next-generation sequencing to study how ecological pressures influence genetic and evolutionary processes.

At HPU, JJ worked with David Hyrenbach's graduate student Illana Nimz to extract and PCR amplify the gut contents of Chocolate (Christmas) Shearwaters in Hawai'i
